sources.evidence: European Watch Company stock 45681 identifies full reference 130.30.39.21.03.001. All nine gallery photographs inspected; front, display back and signed clasp inspected at full resolution. Blue pie-pan dial and fitted steel bracelet match the source. Back shows a distinctive observatory-medallion rotor; the calibre marking is obscured, so the described 8900 movement is not yet promoted as a verified Movement photograph. Clasp STZ004152/JJD/11 markings are specimen details. Source: https://www.europeanwatch.com/watch/omega-13030392103001-omega-globemaster-co-axial-master-chronomete-45681

Phillips HK080216 lot 851 identifies PAM00024. Its single gallery photograph was inspected at full resolution: black dial, date at 3, small seconds at 9, steel diving bezel, crown guard and fitted black Panerai rubber strap. No back, opened movement or buckle is visible. Source-described OP III and buckle do not create photo coverage. Source: https://www.phillips.com/detail/HK080216/851

notPromoted.movement: Omega exact calibre execution awaits further corroboration; Panerai has no movement photograph.
